# `/certification-campaigns` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /certification-campaigns/v1/campaign-filters

`createGovCertificationCampaignFilterV1` — Create a Campaign Filter — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Create a campaign filter based on filter details and criteria. Required roles are ORG_ADMIN or CERT_ADMIN. The request body must not exceed 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes); larger requests are rejected with a 400 response.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-filter:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): CampaignFilterCreate
- Returns 201: CampaignFilterGet

### POST /certification-campaigns/v1/campaign-templates/{id}/generate

`createCampaignFromTemplateV1` — Generate campaign from template — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Generates a new campaign from a campaign template. The campaign object contained in the template has special formatting applied to its name and description fields in order to determine the generated campaign's name/description. Placeholders in those fields are formatted with the current date and time upon generation. Placeholders consist of a percent sign followed by a letter indicating what should be inserted; for example, "%Y" will insert the current year; a campaign template named "Campaign…

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The desired campaign template's ID.
- Returns 200: CampaignGet

  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, created, modified — e.g. `name`

- Body (application/json): SearchRequest
- Returns 200: array of CampaignTemplateGet

### POST /certification-campaigns/v1/campaigns/{id}/complete

`completeGovCertificationCampaignV1` — Complete a Campaign — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

:::caution This endpoint will run successfully for any campaigns that are **past due**. This endpoint will return a bad request error if the campaign is **not past due**. ::: Completes a certification campaign. This is provided to admins so that they can complete a certification even if all items have not been completed. Required roles are ORG_ADMIN or CERT_ADMIN.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The campaign id

- Returns 202: object

### GET /certification-campaigns/v1/certification-tasks

`getPendingTasksV1` — List of Pending Tasks — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a list of pending (`QUEUED` or `IN_PROGRESS`) certification related tasks. Any authenticated token can call this API, but only tasks you are authorized to review will be returned. Non-admin users must include query parameter as `reviewer-identity=me` in the API call.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
